text:
maria: seeing multiple customer tickets (ACME, BetaCorp) reporting 502/504s to Hosted API (eu1) starting ~10:07Z after the model swap. attaching a quick repro and a sample request id: req=9f4a2c.

sam: on it. can you paste the exact curl you used and which endpoint?

maria: curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" -H \"X-Model: rdx-v2.3.1\" \"https://api.eu1.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" -d '{\"prompt\":\"hi\"}'

response: HTTP/2 502
{\"error\":\"upstream error\"}

jessica: I rolled rdx-v2.3.1 to eu1 at 10:05Z as planned. no infra changes. deploy-bot: build/rdx-v2.3.1 -> deployed eu1 (10:05Z).

oncall-bot: paging oncall: incident created INC-2026-4332 for edge 502 spike.

sam: pulling envoy/edge logs now. early signs: many upstream resets (RST_STREAM) and HTTP2 GOAWAYs right after model workers report healthy. snippet: 

```
2026-03-15T10:07:18Z envoy info [upstream] connection_reset: upstream reset by peer id=upstream-47 stream=196
2026-03-15T10:07:19Z envoy warn [http2] GOAWAY received last_stream=193 error_code=ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM
```

sam: also seeing downstream keepalive heartbeats being rejected: keepalive idle window drop at the edge, conn_window=-1 for some upstreams.

jessica: checking worker startup sequence. wondering if model load causes CPU + disk io spike on the worker host leading to slow auth cache calls? redis authcache latency spiked at same time: 20ms -> 1800ms. snippet: 

```
[redis-auth] p99=1800ms t=10:07:12 cluster=authcache-eu1
```

maria: customers report 1) short lived 502s on initial requests, 2) a few 504s for long streaming sessions. ticket ids: #34211 #34235. liz (AM) notifying them and offering pinned routing until fix.

ops: mitigation idea: pin hostedapi traffic for ACME/BetaCorp to previous model variant (rdx-v2.3.0) and increase upstream idle timeout on the edge for eu1 to 30s to tolerate auth backend jitter. can run curl against router API: 

```
# pin routes
curl -X POST https://router-api.internal/tenants/acme/route -H 'Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>' -d '{"model":"rdx-v2.3.0"}'
# bump timeout
curl -X PATCH https://edge-config.internal/eu1 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>' -d '{"upstream_timeout_ms":30000}'
```

maria: customer workaround: set header X-Model: rdx-v2.3.0 in requests until we confirm a fix. confirmed ACME can toggle header.

jessica: hypothesis: simultaneous worker startup + authcache latency caused connection churn on envoys which triggers premature GOAWAYs and stream resets. also seeing auth heartbeat mismatch logs from our proxy: 

```
proxy: auth-heartbeat-mismatch: last_seen=2026-03-15T10:06:50 expected_interval=5s actual=11s
```

sam: agreed. next steps: 1) revert eu1 model to rdx-v2.3.0 (rolling rollback triggered), 2) monitor envoy resets and authcache latency, 3) follow-up postmortem. ops please run rollback now if allowed.

deploy-bot: rollback start -> rdx-v2.3.0 (eu1) triggered by jessica at 10:14Z.

maria: applying customer pin for ACME and BetaCorp now and telling them temporary mitigation.

ops: rollback completed at 10:20Z. early telemetry: 502 rate returned to baseline within ~90s. authcache p99 back to ~25ms. envoy RST/GOAWAY events dropped.

liz: updating customers that we rolled back and are monitoring; offering SLA credit if they observed >30m impact.

sam: leaving this incident open for 24h monitoring. next: create a runbook entry for model rollout gating on authcache p99 <200ms and staggered worker boot, add pre-deploy canary for edge conn churn.

jessica: will add gating checks and change the rollout script to stagger worker activation by 15s. I'll file a follow-up PR and link it here.

maria: thanks all. closing the immediate escalation. will add notes to INC-2026-4332 and follow with full postmortem. :thumbsup:
